summary: Control saved Home Assistant tiles from a low-power panel.
page_description: Keep your favorite Home Assistant controls on a simple, low-power panel.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

steps.text: Expose Home Assistant through HTTPS, using Nabu Casa or a reverse proxy with a trusted certificate.
Create a Home Assistant long-lived access token and install it under the exact name homeassistant.
For a private certificate authority, install its root on the Kobo.
